subject: Attribute & role mapping packet request — SCIM delta and SAML samples (SOC2)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: security@medicore.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Attribute & role mapping packet request — SCIM delta and SAML samples (SOC2)

Hi Alex / security team,

Following up on Medicore's security questionnaire (SOC 2 / CAIQ) — our SOC reviewer asked for a concise package to validate how identities and entitlements are provisioned and mapped. To keep the work scoped, could you share the following items by EOD next Wednesday (May 30)?

- A SCIM delta/export (last 30 days) including attributes used for provisioning (attributes: e.g., userName/email/externalId/groups/title) — CSV is fine.
- Two representative SAML assertion samples (one interactive SSO, one automated service account assertion) with headers preserved.
- A short role-to-group mapping (CSV or XLSX) — how Medicore maps IdP groups to application roles; include any custom claim names.
- A list of service accounts and their assigned roles (redact any keys).

If you prefer, you can upload to the secure Drive link below or send via our encrypted upload. We do not need full logs — just samples and the mapping table. Note: please redact any national ID fields or employee SSNs before sharing.

Secure upload: https://drive.redwoodinc.com/secure/req-8732

Thanks — this will help us complete the control narrative and attribute-matrix for the audit.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Senior Security Analyst, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: redwood_attribute_mapping_template.xlsx (blank template to fill)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medicore.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@medicore.com, Procurement Team <procurement@medicore.com>
Date: 2028-05-24T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Attribute & role mapping packet request — SCIM delta and SAML samples (SOC2)

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide the SCIM snapshot and two SAML samples. I've attached a time-windowed SCIM snapshot (CSV) and a sanitized assertion file; both have had direct identifiers redacted as requested.

Questions:
- Do you need the SCIM export to include historical 'deprovisioned' events or only active users and group assignments?
- For the service account list, do you want creation timestamps and last-used indicators?

We can upload the files to your Drive link or send via our secure SFTP. Expect the first drop tomorrow morning; Procurement looped in for traceability on evidence delivery.

Regards,
Alex Turner
Head of Identity & Access — Medicore Health
alex.turner@medicore.com

Attachments: medicore_scim_snapshot_20280520.csv, medicore_saml_assertions_sample.xml

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medicore.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Attribute & role mapping packet request — SCIM delta and SAML samples (SOC2)

Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications that will make the artifacts consumable for the SOC reviewer: 

- Please include 'active' and 'deleted' events in the SCIM delta (we want to see lifecycle transitions). If that's not possible, the last 30 days of changes + current snapshot will work.
- For SAML samples, preserve the NameID and the raw assertion (sandbox values are fine) and include any custom attribute/claim names used to carry role/group info.
- For service accounts: creation timestamp and 'last used' column are helpful; redact any secret/token values.

Upload preference: secure Drive link is easiest for our team (see earlier). If you use SFTP, send credentials via the procurement mailbox and we'll confirm.

I'll prepare the internal mapping template (attached) and will run an initial mapping pass once we have your files — Jordan will own the mapping exercise on our side.

Thanks,

Jasmine
---

Quick internal note — received the two files from Medicore and the SAML samples look good. I've started the attribute mapping in the attached template and flagged three custom claims (medRole, deptCode, entitlementTier) that need translation to our role model.

Action items for us:
- Finish mapping by EOD Friday (May 31) and produce a one-page narrative for the SOC auditor about transformation rules.
- Confirm redaction for any employee PII before including examples in artifacts shared with auditor.
